sn36.9:1.1: “Bhikkhus, these three feelings are impermanent, conditioned, dependently arisen, subject to destruction, subject to vanishing, subject to fading away, subject to cessation.
sn36.9:1.3: Pleasant feeling, painful feeling, neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling.
sn36.9:1.4: These three feelings are impermanent, conditioned, dependently arisen, subject to destruction, subject to vanishing, subject to fading away, subject to cessation.”
